ai.description: This episode of Bloomberg Tech: Europe, from the Wave by Vento tech conference in Turin, examines how artificial intelligence is moving deeper into banking. Tom Mackenzie explores how banks are using AI to become faster and more efficient, and the new vulnerabilities that could emerge as the technology takes on more consequential decisions. ai.title: Why JPMorgan Is the Most AI-Advanced Bank
ai.description: Artificial Intelligence deployment across banking is moving at its fastest pace yet, with JPMorgan yet again leading Evident Insight’s ranking of the world’s most AI-advanced banks. Evident CEO and co-founder Alexandra Mousavizadeh explains why early movers are pulling ahead and why banks investing most heavily in the technology are still growing headcount even as AI changes jobs. She speaks to Tom Mackenzie on the latest episode of "Bloomberg Tech: Europe." (Source: Bloomberg)

ai.title: Goldman Says Investors to Shift Focus to AI Monetization
